calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, p.sku, p.subcategory, p.category
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT subcategory, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_id, sum(quantity) units, sum(net_amount) net, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) l1, max(etl_loaded_at) l2, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units
FROM l WHERE subcategory ILIKE '%paint%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, count(f.sales_line_id) lines, sum(f.quantity) units
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint') f ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2

WITH sold AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, p.subcategory AS asw_sub, cp.subcategory AS asis_sub, cp.category cat, f.receipt_id, f.line_no
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test'
), ret AS (
 SELECT r.sales_line_id, r.return_date, r.quantity_returned, r.return_line_id FROM fact_return_line r
)
SELECT 'sold_asis' k, sum(quantity) v, count(*) n FROM sold WHERE asis_sub='Interior Paint'
UNION ALL SELECT 'sold_aswas', sum(quantity), count(*) FROM sold WHERE asw_sub='Interior Paint'
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_of_these_lines_any_date', sum(r.quantity_returned), count(*) FROM sold s JOIN ret r ON r.sales_line_id=s.sales_line_id WHERE s.asis_sub='Interior Paint'
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_in_period_for_store108_ip', sum(r.quantity_returned), count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_lines', count(*)-count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(*) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'asis_sub_changed_versions', count(*), count(DISTINCT sku) FROM dim_product p JOIN (SELECT sku s2, count(DISTINCT subcategory) c FROM dim_product GROUP BY 1) x ON x.s2=p.sku WHERE x.c>1

WITH x AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.quantity, f.channel_code, p.category FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT 'fact_all' k, sum(quantity) units, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) receipts, count(*) n FROM x
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_noZZ', sum(quantity), count(DISTINCT receipt_id), count(*) FROM x WHERE category<>'ZZ Test'
